summary.text: Mark McLean is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 15 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an engineer who previously served in the House from 2014 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Mark McLean earned a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from the University of New Brunswick in 1993 and a master's degree in chemical engineering from Northeastern University in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as principal engineer with ams OSRAM, technical account manager with Cookson Electronics, and engineering section head with Photocircuits Corporation.
He has served as treasurer of the Manchester Republican Committee.
McLean served in the New Hampshire House from 2014 to 2016 and returned in 2017, representing Hillsborough 15 since the 2022 election, according to Ballotpedia.
He was vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee for the 2021-2022 session and was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
